pipeline.modality: Small-molecule fixed-dose oral combination (ciprofloxacin + celecoxib, extended-release formulation)

indications.trial_design: Pivotal global Phase 3, randomized 2:1 PrimeC vs. placebo, ~300 patients, US and EU

key_milestones: Phase 2b PARADIGM (NCT05357950) primary completion 2023-11; positive results
FDA positive feedback on Phase 3 design 2024-12
JAMA Neurology publication of PARADIGM survival/biomarker data early 2026
